$comment: Completion bar for #132: accessibility + keyboard. Adds aria-labels (Ask composer, note Title/Body, notes list), a keyboard edit path (F2 on a note), polite/assertive live regions for status/error banners, and a shortcut set (CmdOrCtrl+N new note, CmdOrCtrl+F find, CmdOrCtrl+K ask) via an Electron application menu that forwards 'menu:action' to the renderer. Menu/preload wiring is covered by test:ipc-preload (mocks Electron incl. Menu).

criteria.target: grep -q "Menu.setApplicationMenu" electron/main.ts && grep -q "onMenuAction" electron/preload.ts && grep -q "aria-label=\"Ask a question\"" src/features/ChatView.tsx && grep -q "aria-label=\"Notes\"" src/features/NotesRail.tsx && grep -q "role=\"status\"" src/features/ContentChrome.tsx
